literal_meaning: onomatopoeic expression mimicking sounds of petty squabbling or bickering
figurative_meaning_en: hubbub or commotion; noisy and petty quarrels; ill-feeling or discord
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুই বোনের মধ্যে খেঁচাখিঁচি শুরু হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There's constant bickering going on in the house all day.
A squabble has started between the two sisters.
note: Variations in spelling reflect regional pronunciations in Bengali dialects.
